unitTitle: A week in my life: connect the details
title: Grammar: add, contrast and give a reason
subtitle: A2 · Unit 1: A week in my life: connect the details

steps.title: add, contrast and give a reason
steps.body: At A1, you learned to make clear short sentences. At A2, keep the same clear word order and connect two ideas so the listener can follow your schedule, reason or choice. A connector joins ideas; it does not change the verb form.

steps.title: Choose the relationship between the ideas
rows: Je travaille le matin et j'étudie le soir.
Je suis occupé lundi, mais je suis libre mardi.
Je reporte le cours parce que je travaille.
Le bus est en retard, donc j'arrive plus tard.

steps.title: add, contrast and give a reason
steps.body:
• Say the two ideas first. Then choose the connector that shows their relationship: addition, contrast, reason or result.
• After parce que, use a subject and a verb: parce que je travaille.
• Use donc for the result: Je travaille, donc je reporte le cours.
• Avoid joining every sentence with et. A precise connector helps another person understand your point.
